entities.summary: Douglas Jung was a Canadian lawyer, politician, military officer, and Special Operations Executive secret agent. He was the Member of Parliament (MP) for Vancouver Centre from 1957 to 1962, as part of the Progressive Conservative caucus. He was the first member of a visible minority elected to the Parliament of Canada, as well as the first MP of Chinese and Asian descent in the House of Commons of Canada.
